articles.title: A Robot Dog Outran the Average Human in a Marathon — on One Charge
articles.summary: Engineers in South Korea built RAIBO2, a robot dog that finished a 26.2-mile marathon in 4 hours and 20 minutes — faster than the average human — with a third of its battery to spare.

articles.title: The Movie Warner Bros. Tried to Bury Is Finally Yours to Watch
articles.summary: Coyote vs. Acme was shelved by Warner Bros. until Ketchup Entertainment rescued it. Now the Looney Tunes legal comedy hits digital on September 29, 2026. Rent or buy it on Prime Video, Apple, and Fandango.

articles.title: Injured Pelican Taps on Lab Door — And Scientists Answer
articles.summary: A brown pelican with a hook in its wing and cactus spines in its foot pecked on a NOAA lab door in Florida. Researchers removed the gear in 10 minutes and released it.
